import datetime,difflib,hashlib,json,pathlib
B=pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/actual-source-regular-local-collar-construct')
S=pathlib.Path('/workspace/Math-curvature-20261026/frontiers/source_derivative_gaussian_20261025/SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean')
old=S.read_text();new=old.replace("  letI : Fact (0 < L) := ⟨hL⟩","  let : Fact (0 < L) := ⟨hL⟩")
a="""    nlinarith [mul_nonneg ha (sub_nonneg.mpr hx),
      mul_nonneg hb (sub_nonneg.mpr hy)]"""
b="""    change ε ≤ x 1 at hx
    change ε ≤ y 1 at hy
    calc
      ε = a * ε + b * ε := by rw [← add_mul, hab, one_mul]
      _ ≤ a * x 1 + b * y 1 :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hx ha)
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hy hb)"""
assert old.count(a)==1;new=new.replace(a,b);assertnew=new!=old;assert assertnew
H=B/'history/source-fix001';H.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
(H/'SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean.ORIGINAL').write_text(old)
S.write_text(new)
p=B/'SOURCE_FIX001_FULL.patch';p.write_text(''.join(difflib.unified_diff(old.splitlines(keepends=True),new.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='history/source-fix001/SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean.ORIGINAL',tofile='SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean')))
cachepath=B/'FIRST_ID_CACHE.json';cache=json.loads(cachepath.read_text())
prior=cache[str(S)];orig=H/'SourceActualRegularLocalCollar.lean.ORIGINAL';st=orig.stat();cache[str(orig)]={**prior,'path':str(orig),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'origin':'Known exact previous actual source snapshot ID REUSED; no hash','copied_from':str(S)}
st=p.stat();row={'path':str(p),'bytes':st.st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'first_observed_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'origin':'FIRST necessary new actual patch identity, once'};cache[str(p)]=row
cachepath.write_text(json.dumps(cache,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'scope':'Only quotient001 Fact-style and convex arithmetic defects','full_patch':row,'old_source_ID_reused':prior['sha256']}))
